Subject: Draft MAP skeleton for Novari — quick internal review

Marissa / Ben,

I put together a lightweight MAP skeleton and a companion slide deck to use as our 'first touch' with Novari stakeholders. This is intentionally short — the goal is to (1) align on milestones and acceptance criteria, (2) confirm who owns each milestone on their side, and (3) lock a 4–6 week pilot timeline with two checkpoints.

Key asks for you both before I send to Eli:
- Marissa: skim the acceptance criteria and add any infra/security gating items we should call out explicitly.
- Ben: validate the demo cadence and the recommended test prompts for the eval (I left three sample prompt sets).

Links / attachments:
- Novari_MAP_v1.gdoc (draft) — outline + milestones
- Novari_MAP_deck_v1.gslides (2-slide summary for Execs)
- novari-scope-questions.xlsx (list of technical Qs we want answered during discovery)

I propose the following timeline in the doc:
Week 0: kickoff & infra checklist
Week 1–2: integration + basic eval (latency/cost baselines)
Week 3–4: feature validation + quality tuning + checkpoint
Week 5–6: final acceptance demo + playbook for production rollout

If I don't hear major blockers by EOD today I'll share with Eli and suggest a Wed/Thu kickoff next week (Nov 9–10).

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
